text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Fluconazole is an inhibitor of CYP enzymes such as CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4 [fluconazole:drug_interactions:19], which are responsible for metabolizing warfarin [warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. Consequently, coadministration can increase warfarin exposure and lead to an increased prothrombin time response or enhanced anticoagulant effect [warfarin:drug_interactions:2, fluconazole:clinical_pharmacology:19]. Patients taking this combination should be carefully monitored for adverse reactions and changes in prothrombin time [fluconazole:drug_interactions:19].
